requirements.protection: Public-key authenticity and integrity without issuer callback or shared-secret verification.
requirements.limitation: Primitive strength and future attacks not established by signature vectors.
requirements.evidence_needed: Verify trusted key provenance, altered credential rejection and separation of status from signature verification.
requirements.potential_harm: Forged credentials or reliance on attacker-controlled keys.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Primitive strength and future attacks not established by signature vectors.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Cross-platform operations without privacy or security downgrade.
requirements.limitation: Finite platform sample; scope of wide variety is judgment-dependent.
requirements.evidence_needed: Defined platform set, paired operations, downgrade/refusal and alternative access evidence.
requirements.potential_harm: Incompatibility or weakened protection excludes holders.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Finite platform sample; scope of wide variety is judgment-dependent.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Boolean age predicate, no age or birth-date disclosure; boundary correctness.
requirements.limitation: Side channels and known attack model limitations.
requirements.evidence_needed: Boundary vectors and cryptographic leakage analysis; repeated holder-approved predicates and metadata tests.
requirements.potential_harm: Underlying age inferred despite boolean result.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Side channels and known attack model limitations.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Wallet-agnostic format and import; no preferential provider access; two independent wallets tested.
requirements.limitation: Two wallets do not establish universal availability; informal preferential treatment may escape review.
requirements.evidence_needed: Independent wallet interoperability, provider agreements, registry and actual onboarding access.
requirements.potential_harm: Lock-in or discriminatory access.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Two wallets do not establish universal availability; informal preferential treatment may escape review.

requirements.protection: Independent Department validation of proofing, required standard and assurance, current entity authorization before issuance.
requirements.limitation: Gate tests cannot establish substantive proofing quality; periodic assessments miss deterioration.
requirements.evidence_needed: Actual validation evidence, current authorization and rejected deficient assertions.
requirements.potential_harm: Incorrect endorsement from unsupported proofing.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Gate tests cannot establish substantive proofing quality; periodic assessments miss deterioration.

requirements.protection: Technological enforcement where feasible; documented justification otherwise and current control mapping.
requirements.limitation: Mapping completeness is not validity of feasibility justification.
requirements.evidence_needed: Independent feasibility analysis, actual enforcement, exception rationale and responsible authority.
requirements.potential_harm: Policy-only treatment misrepresented as effective technical control.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Mapping completeness is not validity of feasibility justification.

requirements.protection: Purpose limitation and isolation from non-SEDI Department systems.
requirements.limitation: Insider misuse, exfiltration and new integrations may evade checks.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect data flows, non-program access denial, sharing arrangements and express authorization boundary.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Affirmative per-purpose revocable authorization; immediate block of further access on revocation.
requirements.limitation: Prompt presence does not establish informed choice; review misses changes.
requirements.evidence_needed: Test purpose-specific grant/revocation across downstream access, inspect UX and scope; reconcile with SDI-18 isolation and SDI-22 disclosure restrictions.
requirements.potential_harm: Use continues beyond authorized purpose.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Prompt presence does not establish informed choice; review misses changes.

requirements.protection: Necessary retention schedule and deletion across primary, backup and replica storage.
requirements.limitation: Schedule enforcement does not establish necessity; backup purge may lag.
requirements.evidence_needed: Retention rationale, copy inventory, expiry/deletion and restoration tests.
requirements.potential_harm: Unnecessary retained identity data exposed.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Schedule enforcement does not establish necessity; backup purge may lag.

requirements.protection: Application/proofing data exclusively in state-controlled Utah data centers including replicas.
requirements.limitation: Network location is not physical evidence; inventory can be stale.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect actual storage topology, backup/replica locations and operational control.
requirements.potential_harm: Uncontrolled storage increases exposure.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Disclosure only to subject/guardian or pursuant to valid warrant/court order; no bulk export or informal sharing.
requirements.limitation: Legal validity needs human review; new pathways may evade periodic assessment.
requirements.evidence_needed: Verify subject/guardian authorization, denied requests, legal review, disclosure logs and pathway inventory.
requirements.potential_harm: Unauthorized disclosure through invalid representative or legal demand.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Legal validity needs human review; new pathways may evade periodic assessment.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 9_ Cross-Cutting Technical Requirements _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Non-callback public-key signatures; status checking architecturally separate.
requirements.limitation: Opportunistic callbacks can evade offline tests.
requirements.evidence_needed: Observe online/offline signature paths, trusted keys, separation of status traffic and unexpected callbacks.
requirements.potential_harm: False authenticity or presentation tracking.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Opportunistic callbacks can evade offline tests.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 9_ Cross-Cutting Technical Requirements _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Exclusive holder secret control, proof without disclosure, migration without reissuance.
requirements.limitation: Undocumented OS/hardware backdoors; expert analysis limited by attack model.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect key generation, extraction/duplication resistance, migration, old-instance state and server copies.
requirements.potential_harm: Unauthorized copies undermine holder binding.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Undocumented OS/hardware backdoors; expert analysis limited by attack model.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 9_ Cross-Cutting Technical Requirements _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Cryptographic selective disclosure and predicate proofs; field filtering alone insufficient.
requirements.limitation: Finite attribute combinations and attack models.
requirements.evidence_needed: Review cryptographic construction and negative vectors, metadata and recoverability; clarify SDI-07 structural alternative under combined obligations.
requirements.potential_harm: Hidden attributes recoverable despite selective UI.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Finite attribute combinations and attack models.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 9_ Cross-Cutting Technical Requirements _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Published catalog of publicly standardized royalty-free algorithms.
requirements.limitation: Undisclosed use and deployment drift; EXPT N/A text nevertheless calls for expert source/legal review.
requirements.evidence_needed: Compare actual implementation to catalog and qualified licensing review; seek method clarification.
requirements.potential_harm: Unsupported open-standard claim conceals dependencies.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Undisclosed use and deployment drift; EXPT N/A text nevertheless calls for expert source/legal review.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 9_ Cross-Cutting Technical Requirements _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: SHOULD-level agility, algorithm identifiers, concurrent validation and transition policy.
requirements.limitation: Identifiers and current transition tests cannot predict future dependencies.
requirements.evidence_needed: Test authorized algorithm transitions, downgrade rejection, deprecation/reissuance policy and continuity.
requirements.potential_harm: Algorithm transition causes fraud or lockout.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Identifiers and current transition tests cannot predict future dependencies.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 9_ Cross-Cutting Technical Requirements _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Boolean predicates, metadata leakage resistance, holder control and bounds on repeated inference.
requirements.limitation: Cannot detect every network/hardware/environmental side channel.
requirements.evidence_needed: Evaluate repeated threshold requests, timing/size/errors and explicit holder choice; separate permitted predicate inference from unintended leakage.
requirements.potential_harm: Repeated or side-channel inference reveals attributes.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Cannot detect every network/hardware/environmental side channel.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 9_ Cross-Cutting Technical Requirements _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Published annually reviewed key lifecycle policy aligned with NIST SP 800-57 Parts 1–3.
requirements.limitation: Policy existence not operational conformance.
requirements.evidence_needed: Key inventory, policy coverage, actual ceremonies/configuration and review cadence.
requirements.potential_harm: Unmanaged key lifecycle undermines issuer trust.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Policy existence not operational conformance.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 9_ Cross-Cutting Technical Requirements _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: At least two authorized custodians, split knowledge or multi-party control, independent witnesses, tamper-evident logs and state facility.
requirements.limitation: Documentation cannot detect all-party collusion; witness independence is trust assumption.
requirements.evidence_needed: Ceremony evidence, custodian authority, independent witness and HSM/location proof; examine collusion and actual enforcement.
requirements.potential_harm: Unauthorized signing-key generation or copying.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Documentation cannot detect all-party collusion; witness independence is trust assumption.

requirements.protection: FIPS 140-3 Level 2 minimum, Level 3 SHOULD for root/issuer, no cleartext export, sole Department operational control.
requirements.limitation: API and certificate tests cannot establish physical control or supply-chain integrity.
requirements.evidence_needed: Module identity/configuration, actual key generation/use, operational control and expert review.
requirements.potential_harm: Compromised or externally controlled signing keys.
requirements.disposition_rationale: API and certificate tests cannot establish physical control or supply-chain integrity.

local_risks.name: Unsupported credential authenticity
local_risks.harm: Forgery or unsafe acceptance through untrusted verification keys or incorrectly enforced verification
local_risks.reuse: RK-ID04 concerns DID document manipulation; RK-CY01 concerns ZKP failure. Neither directly represents issuer signature/key provenance.

local_risks.name: Compromised or externally controlled issuance infrastructure
local_risks.harm: Unauthorized issuance, revocation or exposure of identity data
local_risks.reuse: RK-ID03 addresses IDVP breach; RK-EX01 concerns compelled anchors/IDVPs. State-controlled signing infrastructure and ceremony control are distinct.

cases.constructed: Credential validates under an attacker-controlled or stale verification key, or implementation calls issuer when online despite offline test success.
cases.evidence: Verify trust-key provenance, permitted algorithm and invalid/altered vectors; inspect actual online/offline traffic and independent status checking.

cases.constructed: Documented multi-party ceremony and validated HSM coexist with operational custody or backup infrastructure outside the required control boundary.
cases.evidence: Inspect actual physical and operational control, key/copy inventories, ceremony participants and independent witnesses. No inference of collusion or actual compromise.

cases.constructed: Repeated individually valid boolean age predicates and response metadata narrow the underlying age.
cases.evidence: Separate information implied by explicitly authorized predicates from additional leakage; assess repeated requests, timing/size/errors and holder control.

cases.constructed: An authorization is revoked while a copy remains accessible through another system or disclosure pathway.
cases.evidence: Trace purpose-specific authorization, immediate access block, retention necessity and separate disclosure authority; test all copies and interfaces.

limitations: Method applicability and numbered objective coverage reproduce separate source statements; recommended EXPT with no numbered coverage (SDI-04) is not silently assigned objectives.
CRY-03 explicitly excludes field filtering alone, refining SDI-07; evaluate joint satisfaction.
CRY-04 EXPT N/A limitation describes expert audit and legal review; retain clarification.
No actual implementation, operational evidence, risk scoring, guardrail verification or legal determination.
